# thunder_ddos_zone_template_tcp_progression_tracking_mitigation_slow_attack_slow_attacker_identification (Resource)

`thunder_ddos_zone_template_tcp_progression_tracking_mitigation_slow_attack_slow_attacker_identification`: Configure and enable TCP Progression Tracking Identification for Slow Attacker

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tcp_name` (String) Tcp_name

### Optional

- `active_connection` (Number) Set the minimum tracking active connection to start identifying slow attacker, default value is 3
- `bad_connection` (Number) Set the maximum percentage of slow connection (per source), default value is 75
- `enable_identification` (Number) Progression tracking will identify slow attacker and blacklist it based on the config value
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
